title.narrative: Lifesaving WASH intervention in Rural Damascus and Dar'a governorates.

description.narrative: ltpgtltbrgtOxfam is proposing a 15-month WASH humanitarian response in under-served communities of Duma, Zibdin, Rihan and Meidaa in Rural Damascus governorate and Ghabagheb community Dar’a governorates. The project aims to improve safe and dignified access to adequate water and sanitation services for approximately 88,800 direct beneficiaries, contributing to Strategic Priority One of the SHF SA1 2024 Allocation Strategy. The targeted locations fall under the priority sub-districts identified by SHF with inter-sector severity score (3 and 4). The proposed interventions are informed by Oxfam through primary multi-sectoral Rapid Needs Assessment (RNA) conducted by Oxfam during August 2024 through Key Informants Interviews (KIIs) with LWE, DAWSSA, Mukhtars among others. Findings from the RNA were triangulated with secondary information, coordination and consultations with the respective WASH Sub-national Coordinator, I/NGOs, as well as with the Local Water Establishment (LWE), DAWSSA and Head of Municipality’s Sewage department.ltbrgtUnder Output 1.1, Oxfam aims to improve water access for 84,200 people through borehole, pumping station and water tank rehabilitation, network upgrades, and provision of Operation and Maintenance (OM) materials reducing costs of WASH services for HH and ensuring they have dignified access to water. Under Output 1.2., rehabilitating sewage network connections for 4,600 individuals to prevent water contamination, environmental damage, and hygiene and health risks caused by sewage network failures.ltbrgtOxfam has an established office, the Southern Hub, which covers Rural Damascus and Dar’a governorate. Our field teams coordinate at both operational and technical levels with other humanitarian actors and the LWE and Sewage Department at the municipality level. Additionally, Oxfam has a pool of site engineers based in the field to support program delivery. Full support teams, including Finance, Logistics, HR, Admin, and Security, are located at the hub level, managing and operating the response with support from the Country Office. Oxfam will directly implement this response, with proposed interventions coordinated with other humanitarian actors and discussed with the WASH sub-sector. This ensures a high-impact, single-sector approach to increase reach and effectivenessltbrgtltbrgtlt/pgt
